scripts.title: *OP* SCRIPT
scripts.features:
-fills your inv with one of the most op pets in the game at a rate of about 2-3 pets/sec

credits : me

! Note !
The script is not going to work once the easter event is over!
also you should probably afk while it fills up your inv since it's going to lag
scripts.script:
_G.autoEggHunt = true

while _G.autoEggHunt do
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Easter Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "St Patrick Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Frost Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Golem Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Inferno Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Phoenix Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Sand Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Collect", "Bunny Egg")
wait(0.01)
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.Events["__EggHunt"]:FireServer("Claim")
end
